title: Danny Sheehan shown Blue Book files and photo of crashed UFO with symbols
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Danny Sheehan shown Blue Book files and photo of crashed UFO with symbols, about late 1970s (Carter administration) at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You're making me think of the Danny Shehan story where he's taken into a skiff in Washington at the behest of the Carter administration to review the blue book files on all these UFOs and he claims he sees a picture high definition picture of a UFO crashed into a mountaintop and he traced the photo and drew all these like bizarre kind of hieroglyphic looking symbols
No, it was just it was just this room that they had downstairs in the Madison.
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Sheehan, who places it in a downstairs room of the Madison Building rather than a SCIF.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe Sheehan in Washington being shown Blue Book files that included a UFO photograph.

as_told.title: Blue Book UFO photo viewed in the Madison building

plain: A man named Danny Sheehan says that in the late 1970s, under President Jimmy Carter's government, he was taken into a secure room in Washington to look over the files of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. According to Sheehan, he saw a sharp photo of a UFO crashed on a mountaintop, traced it, and copied down strange symbols that looked like hieroglyphs. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, has retold the story calling the room a SCIF, a sealed space for viewing classified material, but Sheehan himself says it was just a room downstairs in the Madison Building, and if his account is true, the government held pictures of a crashed craft.
